reason: The decision body explicitly establishes the append-only retracts mechanism as a founding feature: 'Added an append-only retracts: mechanism to link sidecars so a published lifecycle edge can be downgraded or removed without reopening the block that declared it.'

The decision institutes the foundational rule: 'RESOLVED the source-of-truth-under-collaboration fork: Markdown is authoritative *everywhere* (Invariant #6 reframed), including a future hosted/collaborative tier.' This resolves the debate and establishes the principle.

The decision body says 'Keep model2vec required' which applies/maintains an existing requirement rather than founding it. The concern encompasses three distinct aspects (default provider, silent lexical degrade, only required dep) but this decision only formalizes one pre-existing aspect through testing.

The decision body explicitly establishes the new layout: 'Make .memory-seed/sessions/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md, .memory-seed/sessions/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD/<user>.md, and .memory-seed/sessions/diagrams/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md the new canonical write targets.' This institutes the month-grouped structure.

The decision institutes the scoping rule: 'Detailed session logs remain in the nearest active runtime; parent/root memory gets only coordination summaries.' This establishes the foundational principle for sub-project memory organization.
